title: Whispers of Destiny
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: A Japanese photographer (Ren Takahashi) and a Brazilian architect (Sofia Carvalho) meet on a flight from London to Tokyo and fall in love across London, Tokyo, Kyoto, São Paulo, and Lisbon — a story about fate, courage, and the whispers that guide us toward the people we are meant to find.
style: Lyrical, cinematic third-person prose. Sensory, emotionally precise, long flowing sentences with em dashes. Intimate free indirect discourse.
characters: Ren Takahashi — 34, Japanese photographer; Sofia Carvalho — Brazilian architect who reads Bachelard.
setting: London, Tokyo, Kyoto, São Paulo, Lisbon.
notes: The story recently reached their marriage in Kyoto. Continue beyond it: married life, careers, the push-pull of two worlds, deepening devotion. Keep the romance central.
